title: Confirmation statement for a limited liability partnership (LL CS01)
text:
This form confirms that the LLP details are up to date on the public Companies House register. It costs £110 to file your confirmation statement on paper.

 Registered email address

 You must use part 1 to provide a registered email address if you have not already provided one.

 There’s a different process if you need to  change your company’s registered email address .

 Identity verification

 You must give the identity verification details for all your current members, unless you have already provided this information. See  Verifying your identity for Companies House .

 Restoring an LLP

 If you’re restoring an LLP to the register, you must put the statement date that was due before it was struck off. If you’re not sure of the correct date,  contact Companies House  before completing your confirmation statement.
